issues.title: Missing GWT/Verifies for individual artifacts
issues.why: The module aggregates module-level ACs in 97-acceptance-criteria.md but delegates per-artifact ACs to 79 separate files (01-79-*.md) which are not provided in this context, leaving the actual tool logic unverified.
issues.fix: Include GWT criteria for at least the core validators (01, 05, 24) within the provided module context.

issues.title: Incomplete Error/Concurrency Handling
issues.why: While exit codes (0,1,2) are defined, the spec lacks detail on how tools handle common CI edge cases like locked files, network timeouts for AI auditors, or partial disk writes during 'filler' operations.
issues.fix: Add a 'Resilience' section to the Normative Contract specifying timeout behavior and atomic write requirements for fillers.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Code_Glob' in Contract
issues.why: The Normative Contract uses globs like 'linter-scripts/check-*.{py,sh,cjs}' which may overlap or miss specific files (e.g., .mjs or .go files mentioned elsewhere), creating ambiguity for a coder implementing the health-check logic.
issues.fix: Explicitly list all supported extensions (.py, .sh, .cjs, .mjs, .go, .ps1) in the CODE_GLOB column of the contract.
